title: Arcadian Dream Programmer's Art
body:
# Summary
A small resource pack to add programmer's art to [Arcadian Dream](https://modrinth.com/mod/arcadian-dream). I made this mod because the ores weren't blending in and it evolved into wanting to add more texture changes.

This pack uses textures from the included programmer's art in the game and from [Programmer Art Continuation Project](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/pacp)

# Texture Changes
## Blocks
The ores have been changed to use the original ore texture. The ritual shrine has been changed to use another amythest block texture. The onabashira now uses a the oak log texture.

## Items
The tools all have been updated, the icicle sword and hisou sword have been changed to look like the rest of the other swords. The Houri Elixer and Ibuki Gourd have been changed to look like potion bottles. The time orb is based off the ender peal texture. The patterns and template now use the paper texture. The discs have the white dots removed but are still their respective blue and red colors.

## Armor
The Makaite armor uses an orange tinted iron texture. For the Hihiirokane armor, I simply reshaped the armor to fit the old armor, but kept the cool design (may change later).
